newsitem.title: UK: UK-based MK Airlines to buy DC-8-62 freighter.
newsitem.headline: UK-based MK Airlines to buy DC-8-62 freighter.

text.p: UK-based MK Airlines will finalise the purchase of its first DC-8-62 freighter from an unnamed U.S. source for an undicslosed sum within four to eight weeks, commercial manager Rob Holland said.
The aircraft can carry 45 tonnes of cargo and has 14 freight pallet positions, he told Reuters.
He declined to disclose further information about the plane's acquisition or planned operations for the aircraft as financial details were about to be concluded.
Privately owned MK Airlines, formed in 1990, specialises in freighter operations, mainly from the UK, focusing on Africa, South America and the Middle East.
Apart from its own flights, the carrier's wet-lease customers include Deutsche Lufthansa AG, British Airways, Air Malawi and Air Namibia, Holland said.

Its fleet - all registered in Ghana - comprises three DC-8-55 freighters and a 50-seat/25-tonne cargo capacity DC-8 combi, which is used primarily for entertainment industry charter flights. - Bob Murphy, Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel +44 171 542 7706; fax +5017
